findings.clause: the Causeway Bell is rung without pause until the character is restored
findings.quote: Then she rang until the character had held for the length of a minute more, and stopped.
findings.claim: R3 gives the Bell one stopping condition - the character restored - and the draft has Ada ring on for a further minute past it.
findings.fix: Stop the ringing at the moment the two flashes and the dark resume.
findings.orchestrator_arbitration: UPHELD. Arguably exceeding an obligation rather than breaching one, but the rule names one stopping condition and the sentence was removable without cost. Deleting it outright was the patch.

iterations.note: The Bell sentence was deleted rather than reworded.
